name: Plate Edit
promise: One change to your own footage, comped back so everything outside it stays as you shot it.
cost: $0 in code. The edit pass is generated where you choose, and quoted first.
notes: Bring your own clip as assets/plate.mp4 and the edit pass as generated/edit.mp4, made from that clip with every frame, cut and camera move locked. The pass is never the shot: only its region, inside its window, lands on the plate.

Start the change on a visible cue in the plate and end it before the plate ends. Keep titles and labels in a scene of their own, so nothing draws over the plate. To keep the clip's own sound under the score, set "voice": "assets/plate.mp4" on the scene.

brief.company: A short clip of a lobby, where one pillar turns to glass and back.
brief.audience: Followers of an invented architecture studio
brief.message: One thing changes, and everything else is real.
brief.plate: assets/plate.mp4, filmed on a phone on a tripod, 8 seconds
brief.change: The middle pillar turns to clear glass, the same single object, and back to concrete.
brief.cue: The door on the left opens at 2 seconds.
